results.question: Give me introduction about Tanishk
results.answer:
According to the Tanishk_Product_CV.pdf | page 1 and Tanishk_Product_CV.pdf | page 25, Tanishk Mamoria is a bachelor of technology in chemical engineering from Indian Institute of Technology Ropar (IITRP), specializing with an SGPA score of 8.6 for the seventh semester completed between 2022 and 2026 under CBSE curriculum, having scored 81.8% in his secondary education following ICSE board examinations (completed during 2019) with a high score of 84.6%. Tanishk holds experience as an ML Intern at Reliance Industries Ltd., where he worked on core and mechanical sweeping dust suppressants projects, specifically dealing with waste management solutions in Jamnagar, Gujarat [IIM Questions.pdf | page 25].

His technical skills include proficiency in programming languages like C++, Java, Python, SQL along with strong course foundations in Computer Science and Mathematics including Algorithms & Data Structure, Advanced Calculus, Linear Algebra, Differential Equation [Tanishk_Product_CV.pdf | page 1]. Tanishk has demonstrated outstanding achievements as a coder at online coding platforms like LeetCode (Max Ratings: 2833), Codeforces (Max Rating: 1464) and CodeChef with more than 850+ question submissions, earning him recognition in the form of five stars ratings [Tanishk_Product_CV.pdf | page 2].

Moreover, Tanishk has experience from participating at pitching events like Pitch120 Rulebook where he showcased his technical skills and communication abilities under time constraints similar to real-world startup environments in a presentation round [Pitch120 Rulebook.pdf | page 2].

As part of IIM K's values, Tanishk aligns with the Institute’s mission 'Globalizing Indian Thought by Inculcating Authenticity (Satyam), Sustainability (Nityam) and Fulfillment (Purnam)' [IIM Questions.pdf | page 8]. His educational background in chemical engineering could potentially make him a valuable candidate for projects with an emphasis on sustainability, particularly those related to dust & waste management solutions as mentioned in the IIM_Questions.pdf | pages 25-30 document excerpt.
